# manage-task-context

> Agent execution index. Persist and retrieve explicit task requirements, plans, decisions, progress and evidence across conversation turns.

Read SKILL.md before use. Apply the caller's actual request and authorization; do not infer permissions from repository examples.

## Required context

- Inputs: the current task, permitted scope, and required source/destination paths or time window.
- Environment: Node.js; Python for the optional Hermes exporter. Local session archives must be available and task identity must be established before state creation.
- Read only references needed by the selected mode. Resolve placeholders against the caller environment.
- Preserve input evidence; distinguish observed facts, inferred information and unverified outcomes.
- Verify actual saved output and the selected mode's completion criteria. A ready command, generated draft or successful process is not proof of business completion.

## Authoritative entry

- [SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingyun7842/xignyun-manage-task-context/main/SKILL.md): capability, activation, mode-specific workflow and boundaries.

## Execution references

- [scripts/task_state.mjs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingyun7842/xignyun-manage-task-context/main/scripts/task_state.mjs): Locate or maintain the task state; the default session path is not automatic cross-session task discovery.
- [scripts/context_archive.mjs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingyun7842/xignyun-manage-task-context/main/scripts/context_archive.mjs): Archive and retrieve visible session evidence with source boundaries.
- [references/task-state-schema.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingyun7842/xignyun-manage-task-context/main/references/task-state-schema.md): Read the required state layout and stable identifiers.

## Maintenance

- [PUBLISHING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingyun7842/xignyun-manage-task-context/main/PUBLISHING.md): repository binding, version reasons and synchronization checks.
- [skill-publish.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingyun7842/xignyun-manage-task-context/main/skill-publish.json): public repository configuration.
- [RELEASE_MANIFEST.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingyun7842/xignyun-manage-task-context/main/RELEASE_MANIFEST.json): source version and export checks.
